title: Baseline bounded by the zero-assignment expectation
statement: Let $\mathcal P$ be a nonempty finite family of sign predicates, let $\Omega$ be a finite set equipped with a probability law, and let $a:\Omega\to\mathcal P$ select a predicate for each outcome. The minimum empty-set Fourier coefficient among predicates in $\mathcal P$ is at most the expectation, under this law, of the randomized value of $a(\omega)$ when every input coordinate has mean zero.
hypotheses_covered: A probability law on the outcome space
A map from outcomes to predicates
